summary: Invesco Real Estate Income Trust Inc., a non-traded NAV REIT, filed an Item 8.01 Form 8-K on September 16, 2026, disclosing its monthly net asset value and transaction price. Total NAV was $663.1 million across 24,140,804 shares/units as of August 31, 2026, with the October 1, 2026 transaction price set at each class's August 31 NAV per share. The filing details NAV components including $1.07 billion of real estate investments, $447.7 million of net debt, and $421.9 million of joint-venture non-controlling interests. No special-situation event, board recommendation, or advisor was disclosed.
